title: Conference name badge
hints: Tidy both names first with `.strip()`. Then check whether the last name is empty.
`first.strip().upper()` gives the shouted first name. `last[0]` is the first letter of the last name, and you only take it when `last` isn't `""`.
`first = first.strip().upper()`, `last = last.strip()`, `if last == "": return first`, then `return f"{first} {last[0].upper()}."`
